## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2021-02-04: Amendment No. 1 to Form S-1 attaches the form-of TRA as Exhibit 10.1.
- 2021-02-16: Up-C IPO closes; executed Tax Receivable Agreement dated February 16, 2021 between Bioventus Inc., Bioventus LLC, and Smith & Nephew, Inc.
- 2021-02-17: 8-K announcing IPO close files the executed TRA as Exhibit 10.2.

## Explanation

The TRA originates from Bioventus's February 16, 2021 Up-C IPO, with Smith & Nephew, Inc. as the sole Continuing LLC Owner and beneficiary. Bioventus pays 85% of cash tax savings on Section 754 basis step-ups arising from redemptions or exchanges of Bioventus LLC interests, plus imputed-interest gross-ups on TRA payments themselves. No amendments, restatements, or terminations have been filed. Through December 31, 2025, Smith & Nephew has not exchanged any LLC Interests for Class A common stock, so no liability has been recorded on the balance sheet; this is a normal Up-C disclosure, not a termination signal. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
